source.publication: Instructions for 2025 PIT-ADJ; 2025 PIT-1 Personal Income Tax Return Instructions; 2025 Tax Rate Table (Tax Look Up Table)
source.section: PIT-ADJ instructions PDF page 5, line 16; Form PIT-1 lines 9 to 18 and 22; instructions PDF page 25, line 12; Tax Rate Table PDF pages 1 to 6, rows; PDF page 7 (T-7), over 100,000

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 50,000.00 + long-term gains 5,000.00 = 55,000.00. Federal taxable income = 55,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 39,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; Form PIT-1 takes only the federal line 12 amount, and no line for what the federal return subtracts after line 12). Form PIT-1, married filing separately. Line 9 federal AGI 55,000.00. Line 10 0.00 (standard deduction taken). Line 11 additions 0.00. Line 12 federal standard deduction 15,750.00. Line 13 dependents 0.00. Line 14 0.00: federal AGI 55,000.00 is over the worksheet's printed ceiling 27,500.00 for this status, so the worksheet is not completed. Line 15, PIT-ADJ: line 16 net capital gains: smaller of 5,000.00 and the cap 1,250.00 = 1,250.00; PIT-ADJ line 28 total 1,250.00. Line 17 = 55,000.00 + 0.00 - 15,750.00 - 0.00 - 1,250.00 = 38,000.00. By the projection: state_agi = federal taxable income 39,250.00 - 1,250.00 = 38,000.00; less base deductions 0.00 gives 38,000.00. Line 18 tax, schedule as numbers: 1.5% x 4,000.00 = 60 + 3.2% x 8,500.00 = 272 + 4.3% x 12,500.00 = 537.5 + 4.7% x 13,000.00 = 611; total 1,480.5, to the cent 1,480.50. The table row over 37,900 to 38,000 gives 1,478; expected keeps the formula figure. Lines 19 to 21 0.00. Line 22 net New Mexico income tax 1,480.50. 'A taxpayer and spouse who file separate returns ... may each claim only one-half of the net capital gains deduction allowed on a joint return': 2,500.00 / 2 = 1,250.00.
